data_description.device: Only Mowers set up by a supported integration are listed.

confirm.description: Add {mower} to Mowing Director. Debug recording is on by default and stores Mower telemetry locally; review it in the Mowing Director panel.

data_description.device: Pick the Mower to bind to. Zones are matched by name, so your Plans are kept.

abort.already_in_progress: This is already being configured. Finish the existing configuration before starting again.
abort.no_supported_mower: No Mammotion Mower found. Add the Mammotion integration and make sure the Mower is online first.
abort.run_active: A Run is in progress. Finish or abort it before changing the Mower.

error.no_supported_mower: That device no longer has a usable Mower entity.

missing_zones.title: Zones missing from the Mower's map

init.title: Zones missing from the Mower's map
init.description: These Zones no longer match anything on the Mower's map: {zones}. Delete them and their Plans, or wait if the map is being rebuilt.

menu_options.delete: Delete these Zones and their Plans

abort.waiting: Nothing changed. The Zones stay marked missing until they return.

missing_zones.description: These Zones no longer match anything on the Mower's map: {zones}.

native_schedule.title: The Mower's own schedule is enabled
native_schedule.description: These tasks in the Mower's own schedule are enabled and may start mowing outside the director's control: {tasks}.

init.title: The Mower's own schedule is enabled

disable.title: Disable the Mower's own tasks?
disable.description: This turns off these tasks on the Mower itself: {tasks}. Confirm to continue.

abort.ignored: Nothing changed. Dismiss the issue to hide it.

conflicting_automations.title: Automations also use the Mower
conflicting_automations.description: {count} automation(s) reference the Mower's device or entities and may act on it. Mowing Director never edits automations. Dismiss this if that is intended; it returns only if the set changes.

device_not_found.title: The Mower's device was not found
device_not_found.description: The device for {mower} is gone, for example after the Mammotion entry was re-added. Open Mowing Director in Settings and choose Reconfigure to rebind it. Your Zones, Plans and settings are kept.

source_too_old.title: Mammotion integration is too old
source_too_old.description: Mammotion {version} is older than the supported {minimum}. Mowing Director may misbehave; update the Mammotion integration.

no_zone_sync.message: This Mower has no adapter attached yet.

unknown_entry.message: No loaded Mower has that config_entry_id.

entry_ambiguous.message: More than one Mower is loaded; pass config_entry_id.
